title: Immune Sensor Verdict Record
description: The single shared verdict contract every immune sensor emits (NFR-7, SDD §3.1). Describes ONE single-sensor verdict record. immune-check.sh emits an AGGREGATE record ({verdict, exit, doctors[]}) that composes many of these — that aggregate is out of scope for this schema; this schema governs the per-sensor record each doctor/sensor produces.
$comment: COMPAT (IMP-005): additive-only within a major version. New OPTIONAL fields are a minor bump; a consumer MUST ignore unknown fields — hence NO top-level additionalProperties:false. Removing/renaming a field or changing verdict/exit_code semantics is a MAJOR bump. The verdict->exit_code mapping is the FROZEN compat surface, inherited VERBATIM from tools/immune-check.sh: 0=HEALTHY/clean, 1=INSUFFICIENT (could not ground), 2=PROBLEM. Records with schema_version absent are treated as 1.0.0 baseline by the aggregator.

schema_version.description: Semver of this record's contract (e.g. "1.0" or "1.0.0"). Required on every new-sensor record; absence is treated as 1.0.0 baseline by the aggregator.

sensor.description: The instrument name that produced this verdict (e.g. scope-checks | consumption-doctor | false-green | cluster-compliance).

target.description: What was checked (e.g. pkg:@freeside/adapters | pr:434 | run:bridge-2026-07-03).

verdict.$comment: Open-ish by design (additive compat): a new sensor MAY introduce a new verdict string without a schema bump. Known vocabulary: pass|full|no-consumer (exit 0), flag|suspect (exit 2), insufficient (exit 1); the immune-check.sh aggregate uses HEALTHY|INSUFFICIENT|PROBLEM. The exit_code — NOT the verdict string — is the frozen gate signal.
verdict.description: Sensor verdict token. See $comment for the known vocabulary and its verdict->exit_code mapping.

evidence.description: Free-form but PRESENT: how to reproduce/ground the verdict. May carry a commands[] array of runnable re-check commands, plus source/detail/artifacts.

commands.description: Concrete runnable commands that reproduce the verdict.

exit_code.description: FROZEN mapping (inherited verbatim from tools/immune-check.sh): 0=HEALTHY/clean, 1=INSUFFICIENT (could not ground), 2=PROBLEM. MUST NOT be redefined under a minor bump.

generated_at.description: RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 date-time the record was produced.
